title: Due Diligence Check
description: Record of a due diligence check with type, outcome, evidence reference, and expiry tracking

checkType.title: Check Type
checkType.description: Type of due diligence check performed (e.g., KYC, AML, credit)

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Result of the due diligence check

evidenceReference.title: Evidence Reference
evidenceReference.description: Reference to supporting evidence or documentation

expiryDate.title: Expiry Date
expiryDate.description: Date the check result expires and must be renewed

disclosure.recommendation: Due diligence outcomes should be shared with compliance officers and decision-makers. Detailed evidence references may be restricted to the performing party and auditors.
